title: Relay boot reconciliation can rearm a boundary already handed off in the same process
outcome: Prevent boot paging from resetting a successful live-process relay handoff while preserving restart unread recovery.
acceptance: A boot/live interleaving control proves a boundary handed off earlier in this process is not reset by a later boot page.
Receiver restart after handoff-before-ACK still recovers unread mail, while ACK, Cancel and live duplicate controls remain valid.
